Name: Dry Run
Description: Report what would be fixed without modifying the VMF.

Name: No Backup
Description: Do not write a timestamped .vmf.bak beside the map before editing it.
Warning: The original VMF is overwritten with no copy kept.

Name: Skip Light Falloff
Description: Leave lights whose _zero_percent_distance is nearer than their _fifty_percent_distance alone. VRAD would otherwise discard the authored value and substitute twice the fifty percent distance.

Name: Skip Static Props
Description: Leave prop_static entities alone even when their model lacks $staticprop. VBSP deletes those props from the compiled map.

Name: Check Materials
Description: Also report VMT problems: an undefined $surfaceprop, or $lightmapwaterfog used without $flowmap. Reported only, never edited, since materials are usually shared content.
Warning: Reads every material used by the map, which adds time on large maps.

Name: Skip Prop Fade Distances
Description: Leave props whose fademindist is greater than their fademaxdist alone. Reversed, the engine makes the prop vanish instantly at close range instead of fading out.

Name: Skip Sky Name
Description: Leave a skyname written as a file path (materials/skybox/sky_day01_01.vmt) as it is. VBSP expects the bare name and compiles a black sky otherwise.

Name: Skip Empty Brush Entities
Description: Leave brush entities that contain no brushes in the map. VBSP stops on these with 'bmodel N has no head node', so the map will not compile until they are removed.
Warning: The map will not compile while one of these is present.

Name: Skip Displacements On Entities
Description: Leave displacements that are tied to a brush entity where they are. VBSP stops on these: displacements are only valid on world brushes.
Warning: The map will not compile while one of these is present.

Name: Skip Areaportal Splitting
Description: Leave func_areaportal entities that contain more than one brush alone. VBSP stops on these, since an areaportal must be a single brush.
Warning: The map will not compile while one of these is present.

Name: Skip Overlay Render Order
Description: Leave overlays whose RenderOrder is outside the valid 0-3 range. VBSP stops on these.

Name: Skip Physics Props
Description: Leave prop_physics entities alone even when their model has no propdata. VBSP cannot create those props and drops them from the map.

Name: Skip Problem Report
Description: Do not report map faults that VMFFIX will not repair automatically, such as origin brushes in the world or displacements on non-quad faces. These stop VBSP but have no single correct fix.
